conversation.content: Answer clearly. Treat the following as a self-contained benchmark fixture.

Review the following numbered engineering notes. Identify three memory ownership rules and explain them briefly.

Note 1: The serving worker owns packed expert weights and a bounded set of activation buffers. A producer may reuse a buffer only after its consumer has completed. Queue time, first generated token, decode gaps and thermal hold time are separate measurements. Stable routing preserves expert order and exact zero outputs for routes owned by another rank.
